description:
Relevance-ranked full-text thread search with explicit offset pagination — use to page through a large result set beyond what the main search tool returns. The total is exact when total_relation is 'eq', otherwise a verified public lower bound ('gte'); use has_more and next_from to continue. If pagination_limited is true, narrow the query or section instead of paging further.

Complements the main `search` tool: use this to page through a large result
set with an explicit offset.

from_.description: Continuation offset: the number of results already shown. Pass next_from from the previous page

section.description: Part of the site to cover. Keep the default 'all' for questions and troubleshooting, so threads, news and tutorials all come back. Use 'threads', 'news' or 'tutorials' only when the user asks for that one kind of content, e.g. 'tutorials' for 'show tutorials'.

size.description: Number of results to return (alias: limit)

name: search_elastic
title: Paginated thread search
